ala.text: Ajani Goldmane is born an albino Nacatl on Naya, an outcast among his own pride.
Tenoch steals his kill and savagely beats him, and when his brother Jazal is murdered during a Festival of Marisi, Ajani sets out to learn who did it.
His spark ignites as he leaves Naya, and his first planeswalk takes him to Jund, where Sarkhan Vol teaches him red magic to express his rage.

Elspeth nurses the broken Ajani back to health, and his search for his brother's killer ends in a face-to-face conflict with Bolas, whose soul's essence Ajani summons to fight him until the two dragons vanish.

con.text: Ajani Goldmane arrives on Jund, where Sarkhan Vol advises him, but he threatens Tenoch at a cliff and falls, vanishing into the Blind Eternities.
He wakes in Elspeth's care on Bant and learns that Zaliki killed Jazal at Marisi's manipulation.
Ajani then absorbs the last of the Maelstrom and banishes Bolas from Alara, stopping him from destroying the whole plane.
He declines to become Kha, leaves Naya and entrusts Zaliki with his people.

jou.text: Ajani Goldmane arrives on Theros, becomes a mentor to the leonin and is reunited with Elspeth at Tethmos with Brimaz's help, and together they swear "to set things right."
Posing as the mariner Callaphe, Kiora is hired by Ajani and Elspeth to take them to the Temple of Mystery, where they commune with Kruphix while "repeatedly assailed by Nyxborn creatures."
Ajani then supports Elspeth as she travels to Nyx to face Xenagos on his home ground, and she kills him.

frf.text: Ajani Goldmane travels across Theros, reflecting on gods and on Naya, and makes camp in the mountains in the hope that leonin will find him.
Seza's patrol finds him at dawn and recognizes him, and tells him that Queen Omala died in battle with humans, that Brimaz is now king, and that the gods have vanished, leaving a ring of blank sky.
At Tethmos he is reunited with Brimaz, who sends him to talk to Lanathos about his friend Elspeth.
Lanathos explains that the Champion of the Sun is a title and that the latest champion was seen at Akros, besieged by minotaurs, so Ajani realizes it may be Elspeth and resolves to find her and help.

kld.text: Ajani Goldmane comes to Kaladesh to track Tezzeret, and in Ghirapur he wears mechanical gauntlets made by the Glint-Sleeves at Grandmother Pashiri's request.
He finds her building surrounded by Consulate inspectors, sneaks into her ransacked home and pins a supervisor to a wall, but he knocks the man out, saying "I don't kill."

Vatti meets him on the rooftops and leads him to a renegade safe house, and after Shadowblayde's search turns up word that Pashiri was seen at the Dhund, Ajani follows her scent through the city and finds Nissa with an unconscious Chandra and Pashiri barely breathing.
He frees them from Dhiren Baral's trap, and during the revolt he saves Oviya's life with healing magic after she is wounded protecting Chandra.

When the Gatewatch confronts Tezzeret at the arena, Gideon assigns Ajani to create disruption against the Consulate, and afterward Gideon invites him to join and Ajani speaks the oath, "Until all have found their place, I will keep watch," while also revealing that he once defeated Bolas in the Maelstrom and asking for time to gather allies before anyone goes to Amonkhet.

m21.text: Ajani Goldmane appears on the set's cards as a planeswalker who vows to protect the weak.

dmu.text: Ajani Goldmane digs Karn out of a cave-in, explaining that Jhoira had a tracking spell on her letters, and the two go to the Keldon-Benalish peace summit to warn the leaders that the Phyrexians have returned.
They are met with doubt, and when a Phyrexian knight seizes Aron Capashen, Ajani pursues it, later joining Jaya and Danitha Capashen to attack the Phyrexian cave.
Ertai threatens to have the dreadnought kill everyone unless Jaya and Ajani surrender, but Ajani is soon revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent, compleated by Sheoldred.
At the Battle of the Mana Rig the compleated Ajani kills Jaya Ballard and takes Karn to New Phyrexia.

mat.text: Karn, Kaya, Koth, Melira and Teferi Akosa perform a ritual to un-compleat Ajani Goldmane and Nissa; Melira dies and Karn sacrifices his spark.
Ajani is cleansed of phyresis, and Chandra says she will leave to find him.
He appears to Nahiri, restored and still a planeswalker, and proposes that they make amends together, but she refuses and suspects he has come to kill her.
Nahiri accuses him of slaughtering Theros's gods and murdering Jaya Ballard, and he snarls in grief before the Skyclave dome collapses beneath her.

tdm.text: Ajani Goldmane finds refuge on Tarkir, where he hunts gazelle and is haunted by what he did while enslaved to Elesh Norn.
Nur visits his hut, brings food and warns that his isolation is "just a death deferred," and Ajani answers that it might be punishment for attacking Jaya on the Mana Rig.
While leading Abzan riders in a hunt, Ajani sees a huge red dragon rise and recognizes it as Sarkhan, so he bursts in to warn Felothar's court that Sarkhan has taken control of the wild dragons.

He is reunited with Elspeth and asks Felothar to release her and Narset, then confesses that he joined Phyrexia willingly, but Elspeth tells him he was forgiven before their fight began and he walks away.
Later he leaps from his dragon to save Narset, catches the falling Elspeth and says he came to fight with her in the present, and the three plan to blind Sarkhan until Ugin intervenes.

ecl.text: Ajani Goldmane arrives at Liliana's office at Strixhaven and tells her that Jace has died after losing control of a spell in the Meditation Realm, and that Bolas escaped.
When Dina reports four students missing down an Omenpath, Ajani offers to try to find them, and he traces a flower petal to Lorwyn and goes alone, refusing to take Liliana along.
On Lorwyn-Shadowmoor he fights off beasts, then bursts in on Morcant, saying "My name is Ajani, and we are leaving," and takes Kirol away.
He heals Tam's wound with glowing fingers, Oko gives him the remaining dawnglow for it, and Ajani leads the group, with Lluwen, through an Omenpath to Shandalar and on to Arcavios.

sos.text: Ajani Goldmane becomes Kirol's advisor for an expedition and tells her that trauma awakens a planeswalker's spark and that he lost his brother Jazal.
He catches Kirol when she sneaks off to help and joins the group, but masked figures ambush them and he wakes bound beside Chandra Nalaar, who tells him that Jace is alive.
Ajani insists Jace is dead and unmade, and when Chandra prepares to blast the huge archaic he tackles her, then pins her in a hold, though she still burns the archaic and it tears the ground asunder.

Later he agrees to support Chandra in finding the archaic, but when they find Jadzi healing it, Ajani plants himself between Chandra and the archaic and strikes her forearm with the flat of his axe, sending her fireball wide.

He covers her hand and says they have been through enough, and Chandra gives up and the battle is won; afterward the two recruit Garruk and enter the Echoverse with Vraska, where the Theorist throws them into mental prisons.

fra.text: Ajani Goldmane and Chandra arrive at Vraska's flat to tell her that Jace is alive, and Vraska sends them to recruit Garruk on Muraganda.

Garruk agrees to help in exchange for information about wards, seals and magical containment, and the four climb the tower, where they lose their memories to Jace's effects and Opal tells them they fought him three times.
When they reach the Theorist, he steals Ajani's language and disables his friends before Tam heals them, restoring Ajani's speech.
Ajani pledges support to the Detective, then charges an illusion of Elesh Norn, and later tells Vraska she is not helpless in her choice, though she steps off a building compelled by the sphinx.
He rips the Chain Veil from his double and, once Vraska stabs the Theorist, he and Chandra embrace her as she weeps over Jace's body before the two planeswalk away.
